title: Bounded agent evaluations and installed-module configuration builds
summary: Exercised real Codex/tool integration independently of direct-backend qualification cases.

dates.note: Individual implementation dates are not established; the supplied engineering analysis is an October 5, 2026 snapshot.

facts.text: Tested installed ia-mcp tooling on the Arm cluster by invoking Codex with the MCP interface registered to create valid NCI and CMN configurations and verify successful configuration builds.
The September 2026 completion record reports two successful bounded agent evaluations covering creation and import/modify/diagnose/rollback.

The later testing inventory describes three bounded agent scenario definitions, a separate manual 20-scenario campaign and six broad maintainer scenarios whose blank-context agent execution remains deferred.

notes: Current scenario definitions are not newly executed passes and are not interchangeable with the two historical evaluations.
Configuration builds are not silicon tapeout, synthesis results or full hardware verification.
No repeated-run success distribution, broad autonomous-agent benchmark, model/version comparison, latency/cost study or fleet reliability metric is established.
Installed-module use is currently confirmed, but does not retroactively prove publication at the earlier September completion milestone.
